experiment_data.hypothesis: Sparse activation at 30% and 50% sparsity produces measurable wall-clock inference speedup over dense baseline when using sparse kernels, with 50% showing greater speedup than 30% proportional to compute reduction

metrics.note: No wall-clock speedup without sparse kernels. Mask-based=0.87-0.94x (predictor overhead), structured-skip=0.45-0.74x (gather overhead). Report theoretical FLOPs in paper.
